title: 通知音(アラート音量)を fn+F11/F12 で増減

rules.description: fn+F11/F12 で alert volume(通知音)を増減。素の F11/F12 は通常のメイン音量のまま。

to.shell_command: /usr/bin/osascript -e 'set v to (alert volume of (get volume settings)) - 10' -e 'if v < 0 then set v to 0' -e 'set volume alert volume v' -e 'beep'
/usr/bin/osascript -e 'set v to (alert volume of (get volume settings)) + 10' -e 'if v > 100 then set v to 100' -e 'set volume alert volume v' -e 'beep'
